polar-function.def: A function $r = f(\theta)$ whose input is an angle and whose output is a signed distance from the pole. Its graph in the polar plane is all points $(f(\theta), \theta)$; families include circles, limaçons and cardioids ($r = a + b\cos\theta$) and rose curves ($r = a\sin(n\theta)$, $r = a\cos(n\theta)$).
